subject.title: feat(control-ui): render Mermaid code fences in webchat

question: Should OpenClaw accept built-in Mermaid SVG rendering in Control UI webchat, and if so what sanitizer, dependency, and proof constraints must a current-main implementation satisfy?
rationale: The remaining decision is not a mechanical rebase because it adds a large rendering dependency and a new untrusted-markdown-to-SVG boundary.

options.title: Port and narrow before merge
options.body: Require a current-main port in the markdown-it renderer, removal of the workspace override, scoped scheduling for every renderer surface, bindFunctions handling, and current-head browser/security proof.

options.title: Approve built-in Mermaid explicitly
options.body: A maintainer may accept the dependency and SVG boundary after reviewing sanitizer behavior, bundle impact, and diagnostics as an intentional product/security tradeoff.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: If the feature direction or branch cost is not worth carrying, close or pause this PR and invite a fresh narrow replacement that credits the source work.

recommendation.title: Port and narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Require a current-main port in the markdown-it renderer, removal of the workspace override, scoped scheduling for every renderer surface, bindFunctions handling, and current-head browser/security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects Control UI rendered-output and chat lifecycle surfaces where this history shows adjacent ownership.
